# Coefficient families that no priced scenario's price moves when the family is scaled by 0.8
# (design SUB-11). One line each: the family, then why.
#   never read             no scenario reached a lookup of it
#   read but changes no price   a lookup returned it and no probed price changed
# The list may only shrink. TestEveryCoefficientFamilyChangesSomePriceOrIsListed fails on a family
# not listed here and on a listed family that is now priced. Delete a line when its family is priced;
# never add one to admit a new unpriced family.
#
# WHAT THE LIST DOES AND DOES NOT PROVE. A family here is either a gap in the cost model (the
# registry carries a value the cost model never prices) or a gap in the probe (a layout, backend
# or model it does not try). The probe covers every catalog model on every catalog chip at tensor
# parallel 2, 4 and 8, expert parallel over data parallel, decode- and prefill-context parallel,
# the block sizes and cache dtypes the engine accepts, and the all-to-all backends. It does not
# distinguish the two kinds of gap. The families known to be model-cost gaps:
#   collective_*_int8_*: 108 entries. The cost model prices an int8-served model's collectives
#     with the fp16 entries (kernel/new.go, "an int8-served model's all-reduce is a bf16
#     all-reduce"), so nothing reads the int8 sweeps.
# The rest are not yet classified. Each needs an owning issue before this list can satisfy
# SUB-11's "or is listed as not yet priced with an issue"; none is filed yet.
activation_scratch_floor_bytes # read but changes no price
attention_decode_launch_floor_sparse_mla # never read
